tags.db.query.text: select "id", "name", "description", "options", "meta", "ai_config" as "aiConfig", "type", "cell_value_type" as "cellValueType", "is_multiple_cell_value" as "isMultipleCellValue", "db_field_type" as "dbFieldType", "db_field_name" as "dbFieldName", "not_null" as "notNull", "unique", "is_primary" as "isPrimary", "is_computed" as "isComputed", "is_lookup" as "isLookup", "is_conditional_lookup" as "isConditionalLookup", "is_pending" as "isPending", "has_error" as "hasError", "lookup_options" as "lookupOptions" from "field" where "table_id" = $1 and ("id" in ($2) or "name" in ($3)) and "deleted_time" is null

tags.otel.scope.name: @opentelemetry/instrumentation-pg
